datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Mozambique. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled for medium-term projections at three time points in 2016 (February, June, October), with spatial boundaries and classification values recorded for each surveyed area.
